links.name: Use-Case-Matrix · vault → fabric → gate
links.desc: AURA use-case matrix: classify data and purpose, review a connector, define least privilege, hand off secrets outside AURA, then require a human gate before any external action.
links.body: AURA standard path: scope the use case; classify data; review provider terms and permissions; keep credentials in a dedicated secret manager; document rollback; require explicit human approval. Cataloging or planning never authorizes an external action.
